releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.38 adds a fully local Inbox Combine A4 tool. Choose two shared images in order, preview the first on top and the second below on one balanced white A4 page, then create a single PDF in Documents. The images keep their aspect ratio with comfortable white margins and spacing, and the original Inbox copies are never deleted. Existing Inbox Category/Delete actions, Notes, Library and Instagram work are preserved.
